paragraphs: A multi-timeframe stock breakout scanner for NIFTY 500 constituents. Detects Donchian-style resistance/support breaks with volume confirmation on 1 Hour, 1 Day, 1 Week, and 1 Month bars.
Live app: breakoutscanner.streamlit.app — try it in your browser (no install).
features: Four timeframes: 1H (yfinance hourly), 1D (daily), 1W (weekly resampled from daily), 1M (monthly resampled from 6 years of daily)
Standard — Donchian break + volume surge + strong close
Strict (ATR) — Standard rules + true range > ATR multiplier × ATR(14)
